title: Mixed Event — Stream With Friends♡ Wedding Live! — Episode4 Today's Topic: Minori!

meta.Event Outline: Minori has started doing solo walking-tour streams as part of MORE MORE JUMP!'s activities. One day, she follows a viewer's recommendation to check out the Phoenix Bridal Fair!

rows.Line: Phoenix Bridal Fair Venue

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wow, that's pretty...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, it is.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: This is my first time hearing about planetarium weddings, but it's incredible how they can project the night sky onto the walls and ceiling like this...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I could look at this all day.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Actually, we've been here for a while now. Wanna head out?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Whoa, my eyes...
It's so bright out here...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
M-My eyes are also still trying to adjust...
Why don't we sit on that bench for now?
se_walk_women_002_1
se_walk_women_002_2

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you for coming here with me today, Shiho. I had so much fun last time, I just had to come back...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
It's all good.
I managed to buy everything I needed for practice, and I didn't have anything planned afterwards.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Plus, it was worth the trip.
I didn't realize that you could hold weddings at live houses.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I wasn't expecting to have the option to play actual instruments on stage.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Me neither.
It's pretty common for bands to come play at a wedding, but...
Huh?
Wait a second... Honami? Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: E-Ena...?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I had a feeling it was you two.
Did you come together?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, we did.
What brings you here, Ena?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I came to see the dresses they have on exhibit.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I was thinking about doing an oil painting of one for my art class. It's hard to capture those ruffles just right.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Have you two been to the dress area yet? It's just over there, and you can apparently try them on.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, I got to try one on last time, so I might...

Aha!
There's the fitting area!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Huh?
That sounded like...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Minori...?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, in the fitting area, you can try on all these different dresses!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wait, hang on...
You can try on literally all of them?!
That's amazing!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<That red one in frame's gorgeous.>
<Oh, the one with the mini skirt's really cute.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: They even have professionals on site to do your hair and makeup, so you can just come as you are and become a beautiful bride. Plus, I'm sure you'll find a dress you like.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Whoa, they've really got everything!>
<I'd need at least an hour to choose a dress.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. This fitting area is the Bridal Fair's main attraction! I hope you all get a chance to try some of these on when you visit!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But since we're here...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm gonna take this opportunity to try one on!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Woohoo!>
<I can't wait to see you in a wedding dress, Minori!>
<Try the pink dress! Or that white and blue one!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. You'll just have to wait and see♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Anyway, I'm gonna go get cha—

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh... W-Wait, Hanasato...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What do we do about your stream while you're getting changed? You're also getting your hair done, so it's gonna take thirty minutes at the very least...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
O-Oh, that's right...!
I thought I'd just get changed in a flash... I didn't think it through at all!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Thirty minutes? What do I do until then?>
<Things won't be the same without you, Minori.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
R-Right...
A stream with no one talking does sound bad...

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line: <Oh, does that mean this is gonna be the Nene Show for the next thirty minutes?>

rows.Speaker: Minori & Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Hey, good idea!>
<I wanna hear more about you, Nene!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Slow down, you guys!
Nene isn't a streamer, so asking her to take over all of a sudden is too much...

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Aww!>
<All she'd have to do is talk like she would normally.>
<Still, we shouldn't force her.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I-If it's just for a little bit, then...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I mean, I'm trying to become a professional actress, so I do sorta need to be able to improvise if there are people who want me to...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
B-But are you sure...?!
You don't look so good right now...!!!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<So, the Nene Show's happening?!>
<Can you talk about PXL?>
<Awesome!>

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<She's gonna take over?>
<What are you gonna talk about?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: S-So many comments are coming in...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-They want me to talk that much...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I-If that's the case, Hanasato, I'll take over for now...! Feel free to go get changed...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(I-Is she really gonna be okay...?
She looked like she was preparing to go into battle just now...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Alright, what should I talk about...?

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<How did you and Minori first meet?>
<What's Minori like in real life?>
<What's your personal impression of Minori?>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, interesting...
Most of you seem to want me to talk about Hanasato...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Th-Then, let's get started...
We can call this segment...
“Ask Me Whatever You Like About Hanasato”...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: O-Or something...

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Yay! A surprise segment!>
<Instant classic!>
<This one needs to be archived forever.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hahaha...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
So...
I guess I should start by talking about how we first met, huh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But that means talking about Hoshi...
I'd have to talk about another one of my friends, and how we attend different schools...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
W-Wait...
I'm not supposed to talk too much about my private life, am I...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Th-There's smoke coming out of Nene's head!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (What do I do...?! Everyone was looking forward to hearing her talk, but she's totally starting to panic...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Is it really okay for me to go get changed right now?!)
Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh...?
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Shiho? Honami? Ena?
You guys were all here?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, we just happened to run into each other a second ago. Wait...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sorry, were you in the middle of doing a stream? It looked like you were talking towards your phone just now...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah, the thing is...!
I'm having a friend temporarily take over for me, but...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We really didn't know. Sorry for interrupting.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We'll move to a different area, so please feel free to continue streaming.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-Thanks, I really appreciate it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Let's all talk the next chance we...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wait a second...
All of us... Talking...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: S-Sorry, but I need to ask you all for a really big favor!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Whoa, you scared me.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: How can we help, Hanasato?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
S-So...!
If possible...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Would you be willing to help my friend answer questions about me during her segment?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Answer questions about you...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Now I see...
So Kusanagi's over there doing what she can.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah...
But...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It looks like she's really at her limit, so I can't just leave her!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Then, okay...
I can help as long as I don't have to show my face in front of the camera.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Really?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean, we can't really leave Kusanagi to fend for herself like this.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I don't know how much I'll be able to contribute, but I promise to do my best...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I figure you two would be able to cover things...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But I guess we're all in this together.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Honami! Ena!
Thank you both so much...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then, please help her! I'm gonna go get changed as fast as I can!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, have fun.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Let's go help Kusanagi, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Alright, so now...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Three of Hanasato's friends will be joining me as I keep answering questions about her...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho, Honami & Ena
rows.Line: Nice to meet you all.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Cool!>
<An all-star lineup of Minori's friends?!>
<I can't believe so many have gathered here!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Their offer sort of took me by surprise...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(But I really appreciate the help.
Acting is one thing, but being an MC's a whole different story.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Still, how to move this conversation along...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I've talked to Mochizuki and Hinomori before, but really haven't with Shinonome...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Can you tell us what you've been talking about up to this point, Kusanagi?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, so... I've been answering questions that Hanasato's viewers have about her.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: About her?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yes.
What my friendship with her has been like, what we've done together...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Your friendship, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: In my case, we just started out as classmates. We were in the same class together during our first year.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, really?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So... What was your first impression of her?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: My first impression...? Well...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Mostly that she kept coming over to talk to me...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It doesn't sound like you were a fan.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
It's not like that.
Back then, I sort of just preferred to be by myself.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But as time went on, we gradually got to know each other better. We started having lunch together, she showed me the ropes of the animal caretaker committee...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And we even went to the zoo together to tend to real animals.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Oh, she talked the other day about how she went to the zoo with a friend!>
<That was you?!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Taking care of real animals at a real zoo...? That sounds like a lot of fun.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, since we're on the subject, can you tell us more about what you guys did?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We mostly just cleaned their pens and fed them.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Actually, when Minori tried to feed the shoebill they had there, he ended up completely ignoring her... I know I shouldn't have laughed, but I couldn't help myself then...

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<I can totally see that happening.>
<As bad as I feel for her, that's a really cute story.>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
But they did become closer at the end.
Best friends, in her words.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. She's best friends with a shoebill?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
But I can sort of picture it.
Minori's silly and clumsy, but in such a cute way.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I got to know her when we went to SpoJoy Park together. When we went rollerblading, she ended up going for a tumble while trying to help this other friend of mine.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
What?
W-Was she okay?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, she didn't get hurt.
If anything, she was more worried about my friend.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hehe. That definitely sounds like her.
She's always doing her best for the sake of others, but in a slightly funny way...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Actually, something similar happened just the other day.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: This dog and his owner were preparing to compete in a disc dog competition, but the owner ended up getting injured. To my surprise, Minori volunteered to take his place.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh?! How does that happen?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Thank goodness...
I wasn't sure how this was gonna go at first, but we've managed to get a good conversation going.)

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<I'm hearing about so many of these things for the first time!>
<It's fun to hear all these stories about Minori.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (And I'm really glad that Hanasato's fans seem to be enjoying themselves.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But also...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I had no idea that she was friends with so many different people.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Thirty minutes won't be enough at the rate we're going. We could easily do this for a whole hour.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, Kusanagi, I'd like to hear about any stories that you have.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? A-Any that I have?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I wanna hear too.
Tell us about what you and Minori have done together.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
O-Okay...
I don't know if I'll be able to tell this story right...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I got my biggest impression of her when...
